title: NeuroFlow Extension: niivue/ui
description: Reference schema for the niivue/ui extension namespace. Describes designer-palette, menu, and form metadata used by NiiVue Desktop. This is an extension contract, not part of the portable NeuroFlow core.

menu.description: Menu heading a workflow appears under.

form.description: Custom form layout for reviewing and editing context fields.

block.description: Designer-palette metadata for a tool. A single object produces one palette entry; an array produces multiple variants.

fields.description: Context field identifiers displayed in this section.

component.description: Optional registered custom component name instead of auto-generated controls.

buttonText.description: Custom label for the primary action button when this is the last section.

postCompletion.description: If true, this section renders after engine steps execute.

blockDef.description: How a tool appears as a block in the visual designer.

label.description: Friendly label shown in the palette.

description.description: One-line description shown below the label.

defaults.description: Pre-filled input values hidden from the user form.

exposedFields.description: Tool input names that appear in the user-facing form.

hiddenFields.description: Tool input names that are hidden.

requiredContextFields.description: Extra context fields the block's form component reads at runtime.

contextFields.description: Inline context-field definitions for fields exposed by this block that don't map to a tool input/output.

condition.description: Optional dot-path condition expression for conditional execution.

heuristics.description: Map from exposed field name to heuristic name that auto-populates it.
